digest_method: sha256 of ordered canonical lines '<path>:<Git blob SHA>\n' for adapter.md, run-record.schema.json, then runner.py
contamination_boundary: After this bundle is frozen, an independent evaluator may author the decisive CG-06 fixture and grader. Candidate authors must not inspect their decisive details before scoring and must not make behavior-relevant core/bundle changes until the scored run completes.
limitations: The bundled runner implements deterministic orchestration and observable trace capture but still requires an external JSONL candidate executor.
A valid scored run still requires sealed held-out artifacts and independent calibrated judgment grading.
PASS cannot transfer automatically to a later production or applied Skill.
